verses.text: In gana swalb'at junxo tik t'ayex: Q'uinalok ay junok uninab'il tz'ikankan masanil tastak ay t'a smam. Wach'chom syikejkan smasanil, palta ayik yuneto, lajan tz'ajkan icha junok majan.
Ayto mach tz'ak'an mandar, syilan tastak ay t'ay, masanto sja sk'ual ayik syalan smam to ay yalan yik t'a smasanil.
Hanhejtona' ichonhta'. Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, ichato unin onh, yujto onh ak'ji mandar yuj b'eyb'al yik yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Palta ayik ix k'och stiempoal, ha Dios ix ak'ankot Yuninal, ix alji t'a jun ix ix icha tz'aj kalji ko masanil. Ix ak'ji mandar yuj ley Moisés.
Icha chi' ix aj yuleq'ui, yik tzonh skolkanel t'a yalanh jun ley chi', yik tzonh yik'och Dios yuninalok.
Ha Dios ix ak'ankot Yespíritu Yuninal chi' t'ayonh, yik skojtakejeli to yuninal onhxo. Yuj Yespíritu ayoch t'ayonh chi', skal t'a Dios icha tik: Mamin, xko chi.
Yuj chi' manhxo ichok junok chekab' kaji, yujto yuninal onhxo Dios yuj Cristo. Yuj chi' kikxo masanil tastak ol yak' Dios t'ayonh.
Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, manto eyojtakok Dios. Eyak'nak serwil juntzanh komon Dios, palta manh diosok.

Haxo tiknaik, eyojtakxo Dios, más wach' skal icha tik to ojtakab'il exxo yuj Dios chi'. Yuj chi', ¿tas yuj tzex meltzajxi t'a juntzanh b'eyb'al malaj yelk'och chi'? ¿Tas yuj he gana eyak'anxioch he b'a t'a yalanh jun ley chi', tzeyak'anxi serwil?
Ina tzato he k'anab'ajej juntzanh q'uinh yik junjun sábado, juntzanh q'uinh ayik tz'alji k'een uj yet' juntzanh q'uinh yik smolchaj sat awb'en yet' juntzanhxo q'uinh tz'och t'a yuktakil ab'il.
Yujto icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, swak' pensar, talaj nab'anhej in munlajel t'a he kal ta'.

Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', tzin tewi t'ayex to tzeyik'el he b'a t'a yalanh jun ley chi' icha ajnak wik'anelta in b'a a in tik. Yujto a in tik, ek'nak in t'a yalanh jun ley chi' icha tzeyutej he b'a chi' tiknaik. Ayik wek'nak t'ayex ta', wach'nhej eyutejnak he b'a t'ayin.
Eyojtak to ayik wek'nak t'ayex t'a sb'ab'elal, yuj jun yab'il ochnak t'ayin yuj chi' kannak in walel jun wach' ab'ix yik kolnab'il t'ayex.

Wach'chom eyab'nak syail wet'ok yuj jun in yab'il chi', palta maj in he patikejel-laj, maj in he chakeli. Icha skutej ko chaan junok yángel Dios, icha chi' eyutejnak in he chaani, ichato a Jesucristo he chanak.
Ayik wek'nak t'ayex chi', wal yel te tzalajnak ex. Q'uinalok tato yalnak, eyik'nak am elta yol he sat eyak'annak t'ayin. Palta, ¿b'aj ix k'och jun he tzalajk'olal chi' tiknaik?
¿Tom skajk'olej ko b'a heyet'ok yujnhej to swalb'at jun k'ayb'ub'al te yel tik t'ayex?
Ay heb' niwanok tzex xajanani, palta manh yujok he wach'ilok. Ha spensar heb' to tonhej tzex smontejel heb' yik tzeyak'anoch he pensar t'a heb'.
Wach' toni tato ay mach b'aj skak'och ko pensar, palta tato t'a ko wach'ilok. Oktom icha chi' tzeyutej he pensar t'a masanil tiempo t'ayin, manhoknhej ayik ay in ek' eyet' ta'.
Ha exxo, icha wal to wune' ex, swab' wal syail eyuuj, icha junok ix ix tz'ab'an syail yalji yune'. Ichanhej chi' swab' syail eyuuj, masanto ol lajanb'ok he pensar yet' Cristo.
Oktom ayinek' eyet' ta' tiknaik, yik manh ichok tik swutej walan t'ayex, palta maxtzak nachaj wuuj tas wach' walan t'ayex.
Ha exxo, he gana to a ley Moisés tzex ak'an mandar. Palta ¿tom max he nakoti tas syal jun ley chi'?

Yujto syal yuj winhaj Abraham to ay chawanh yuninal winh. Ay jun aljinak t'a ix Agar, ix schekab' heb'. Ay pax junxo aljinak t'a ix yetb'eyum winhaj Abraham chi', haton winhaj Isaac. Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Abraham chi', munil yik sb'a ix, malaj junokxo b'aj ochnak ix chekab'ok.

Ha jun yune' ix schekab' heb' chi', tonhej ix alji icha tz'aj yalji junjun anima. Haxo junxo aljinak t'a ix munil yik sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum chi', yuj spoder Dios aljinak, yujto yak'nakkan sti' Dios yuj.

Ha yab'ixal heb' ix tik, ch'oxnab'il yaji. Ha chawanh heb' ix ix tik, a chab' strato Dios sch'oxel heb' ix. Ha ix Agar chi', sch'oxkot jun strato sb'onak t'a jun tzalan Sinaí. Ha heb' yik jun trato chi', ichato yune' ix yaj heb'. Chekab' yaj heb' icha aj yek'nak ix.

Ha ix Agar chi', a jun tzalan Sinaí ay t'a yol yik Arabia sch'oxkot ix. Ha chonhab' Jerusalén ayek' tiknaik, yikto tzalan Sinaí chi', yujto a heb' yik jun chonhab' chi', ayoch heb' t'a yalanh smandar jun ley chi'.
Haxo junxo Jerusalén ay t'a satcha'anh, haton ay onh yiko'. Yuj chi', kik ko b'a, maxtzak onh ak'ji mandar yuj jun ley chi'.

Ha t'a Slolonel Dios Tz'ib'ab'ilkani, hata' syalkan icha tik: Wach'chom toxonton malaj une', palta tzach tzalaji. Manh ojtakok chajtil syail yalji unin, palta elokab' aw yuj tzalajk'olal. Yujto a jun ix skan sch'okoj, ek'alto sb'isul yune' ix ol aljok t'a yichanh ix ay winh yetb'eyum, xchikani.
Ex wuk'tak ex wanab', lajan onh icha winhaj Isaac chi'. Yujnhej to yak'nakkan sti' Dios, yuj chi' tzonh och yuninalok.

Palta ha t'a peka' chi', a winh tonhej aljinak icha tz'aj yalji junjun anima, yak'nak och yaelal winh t'a yib'anh jun aljinak yuj spoder Yespíritu Dios chi'. Icha yutejnak sb'a winh chi', icha chi' tzonh utaj yuj heb' anima tz'ak'ji mandar yuj ley chi' tiknaik.

Palta a Slolonel Dios chi', ha' tz'alani: Ha ix chekab' yaj tik, pechel ix yet' yune' tik, xchi ix Sara t'a winhaj Abraham chi'. Yujto a jun yune' ix chi', malaj yalan yik schaan jab'ok tas yet' jun yune' ix yik sb'a sch'okoj yet' winh yetb'eyum chi', xchikani.
Yuj chi' ex wuk'tak ex wanab', manh onh lajanok icha jun yune' ix chekab' yaj chi'. Palta lajan onh icha jun yune' ix munil yik sb'a yet' winh yetb'eyum chi'.
